usedFor: Shopify publishes blog articles and Content Workflow Bynder tracks content, so “New Blog Article” can run “Create New Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Blog Article” in Shopify, then “Create New Item” in Content Workflow Bynder
bestTemplate.why: Each published article gets a content item with a name, status and folder, ready for review.

watchOut: “New Blog Article” in Shopify runs when an article is published, so drafts do not reach “Create New Item”.
